title: SOC Analyst
description: A roadmap for security operations: networking, logs, SIEM, alert triage, incident response, threat intelligence, detection rules, and SOC portfolio labs.

tree.name: Security and Networking Foundations
tree.description: Build the base needed to understand alerts: networking, Windows/Linux basics, identity, malware, web attacks, and security controls.

resources.title: How to Become a SOC Analyst (WsCube Cyber Security)
SOC Analyst Complete Roadmap (Hack to root)

children.name: Networking and OS Logs
children.description: Understand TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP, Windows Event Logs, Linux auth logs, process activity, and endpoint telemetry.

children.name: Common Attacks
children.description: Recognize phishing, brute force, suspicious PowerShell, malware beacons, web attacks, lateral movement, and data exfiltration.

tree.name: SIEM and Alert Triage
tree.description: Use SIEM tools to search logs, validate alerts, enrich events, prioritize incidents, and write useful case notes.

children.name: Log Search and Correlation
children.description: Search by host, user, IP, hash, process, URL, time window, event ID, and correlate across data sources.

children.name: Case Notes and Escalation
children.description: Document evidence, impact, timeline, scope, false-positive reasons, next actions, and escalation paths.

children.name: Practice: Suspicious Login Triage
children.description: Investigate login logs, IP reputation, impossible travel, MFA status, device history, and escalation notes.

tree.name: Detection Engineering and Incident Response
tree.description: Move from reacting to alerts toward writing detections, tuning rules, hunting threats, and improving playbooks.

children.name: Detection Rules
children.description: Write Sigma/YARA-style detections, tune noisy alerts, map to ATT&CK, and test with sample telemetry.

children.name: Threat Hunting
children.description: Use hypotheses, indicators, baselines, timelines, ATT&CK techniques, and hunting reports.

tree.name: SOC Lab and Career Readiness
tree.description: Build evidence of SOC skill with home labs, alert writeups, detection rules, reports, and interview stories.

children.name: Home Lab
children.description: Run Security Onion, Splunk, Wazuh, sample logs, attack simulations, and incident response notebooks.

children.name: Project: Alert Triage Portfolio
children.description: Analyze sample alerts, write case notes, build a timeline, classify severity, propose detection tuning, and publish a report.
